subject: ONE male spotted hyena, grey work shirt-apron, toothy grin
second_characters: ONE goat boss in a grey vest, grid printouts under his arm from the first beat
props: ONE paper crown cut from a grid printout; ONE empty white ceramic bowl; printouts show grid lines only, no digits, no text
environment: busy office break room by day: metal lockers, tall glass panes, kettle on a shelf; meerkat coworkers scurry past with folder stacks, two pop up over locker doors
motion_rule: the hyena runs or walks sideways through the room EVERY beat, never stands in place. He fills at least half the frame height, except the three close-up beats where a muzzle or a flying bowl fills the whole frame. Props only carried, hurled or snatched on the run. Cuts only at 3.0, 3.4, 5.5, 8.0; between them the camera tracks him continuously from the side, changing angle and shot size at each cut.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.4; no words 1.65-1.95, 3.0-3.4, 4.85-5.5; last word by 6.6; no words after 6.6
audio.lip_sync: the hyena speaks, jaw working on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: me-NYA pa-VY-si-li. STAR-shiy YEST PER-vym. TUT PER-vym ga-la-DA-yet. za-TO f ka-RO-ne
audio.sfx: office chatter, bowl clang, paper crunch, belly growl

timeline.a: the hyena runs in sideways, snatching the crown from the goat's hoof; the hoof at the lens

a meerkat with folders darts across the lens, then the hyena scurries sideways, hunched, across the room, the empty upside-down bowl at his chest
